{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute summary statistics for revenue
summary_stats = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].describe()

# Check for outliers using IQR method
Q1 = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].quantile(0.25)
Q3 = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].quantile(0.75)
IQR = Q3 - Q1
lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR

# Identify outliers
outliers = completed_orders[(completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] < lower_bound) | (completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] > upper_bound)]

# Print summary and outlier info
print("Summary statistics:")
print(summary_stats)
print(f"\nIQR bounds: [{lower_bound:.2f}, {upper_bound:.2f}]")
print(f"Number of outliers (outside IQR bounds): {len(outliers)}")
print(f"Outlier values: {outliers['revenue_numeric'].values}")"}
